caption:
Monday's Sky is Yin Fire, The Candle Flame 🕯️ Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's small steady flame meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yin Fire gets a friend day, Yin Wood gets a joy day, Yin Metal feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

How's your Monday going? Comment your element below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #astrology #zodiacsigns #personalgrowth #metaphysics #bazi #chinesemetaphysics #fiveelements #mondaymotivation
day_line: A candle flame on a Pig day. Warm and cosy: good for focused work and kind gestures, easy to burn out by evening.

lines.Yang Wood: Monday meeting, strong opinions. Lead with one point, not five.
lines.Yin Wood: Monday feels lighter for you. Bring snacks and be the office mood-lifter.
lines.Yang Fire: Someone shines in your lane today. Team up instead of competing.
lines.Yin Fire: Your people are on your side today. Ask the group chat for a hand.
lines.Yang Earth: A kind word steadies you today. Take the advice; skip the second-guessing.
lines.Yin Earth: Your gut is right today. Quietly fix the thing everyone else missed.
lines.Yang Metal: Eyes are on you today. Show up on time and the rest falls into place.
lines.Yin Metal: Monday hits hard today. One task at a time; lunch is not optional.
lines.Yang Water: Steady work pays off today. Clear the backlog before the fun stuff.
lines.Yin Water: A door opens a little today. Reply to that message quickly.
